title: Phase 3A.2 Hardened Source Verification Record
description: Normalized and hardened schema for source verification records with strict evidence provenance and identity requirements

sourcePackSourceId.description: Source ID from the frozen discovery corpus

verificationSourceId.description: Source ID in the verification ledger

titleMatch.description: Whether observed title matches discovery title (exact or normalized)

titleMismatchReason.description: Explanation when titleMatch=false. Required if titleMatch=false and verificationStatus=VERIFIED

publicationDateObserved.description: Publication date from source or discovery corpus

publicationDateEvidence.description: Explicit provenance for how publication date was determined

versionDateObserved.description: Version date if different from publication date

pageLastModified.description: HTTP Last-Modified header or page metadata timestamp (NOT publication date)

sourceExists.description: Whether the source URL is accessible/exists

sourceIdentityVerified.description: Whether source identity was verified against discovery record

VERIFIED_requires: if titleMatch=false then titleMismatchReason must be non-empty
BLOCKED_requires: notes must explain the blocking reason
FAILED_requires: notes must explain why source is considered failed (not tool error)
validationRules.publicationDate_rule: publicationDateEvidence must not be SYSTEM_CLOCK or transport timestamp
